name: lut-studio
description: A darkroom-style photo editor that runs entirely in the browser: develop RAW files with a Lightroom-style panel (white balance, tone, presence, histogram, auto tone), then stack 44 generated LUT looks or import your own .cube. Full-resolution JPEG export — no accounts, no server-side processing.

scripts.predeploy: npm run build:luts && npm run build:gz
